sensor_type: OLCI (Ocean and Land Colour Instrument, 21 bands) + SLSTR (Sea and Land Surface Temperature Radiometer)
revisit_time: Less than 2 days globally (A+B tandem constellation)
description: Sentinel-3 is a multi-instrument ocean and land monitoring mission providing global coverage at medium resolution. Its OLCI sensor enables large-scale water body monitoring and flood extent estimation, while SLSTR provides surface temperature data useful for assessing flood-affected areas and evaporation dynamics.

flood_detection.notes: OLCI water bands enable flood detection at 300m resolution; suitable for large river and coastal flood events

flood_extent_assessment.notes: Global Surface Water monitoring at 300m; best suited for large-scale flood extents covering hundreds of square kilometres

cloudy_conditions.notes: Optical instrument; cloud cover limits observations, though near-daily revisit improves cloud-free chance

night_operations.notes: Passive optical sensor; no night-time capability for OLCI

emergency_response.notes: Near-daily coverage supports operational monitoring of evolving large-scale flood situations

strengths: Near-daily global revisit (< 2 days with A+B tandem)
Wide area coverage at 300m enabling continental-scale flood monitoring
21 OLCI spectral bands optimised for water and land colour
Synergy between OLCI and SLSTR instruments
limitations: 300m resolution too coarse for detailed urban or small river flood mapping
Less commonly used than Sentinel-1/2 for emergency flood response
recommended_for: Large-scale river basin and coastal flood monitoring
Continental overview of flood evolution over multiple days
Land surface temperature change detection in flooded areas
